claims.claim_text: Woodward has significant content on the F-35 Lightning II fighter program and counts it among the 'newer programs' increasing in production, supporting defense-segment growth in fiscal year 2024.
claims.subject: Woodward
claims.object_value: F-35 Lightning II (Air Force fighter program of record)
claims.source_quote: We also have significant content on defense applications such as Blackhawk and Apache helicopters, F-35 and F-15 fighter jets, and guided tactical weapons. ... some newer programs increase (e.g., F-35 Lightning II and T-7A Trainer)

queries.rationale: CV-22 (AFSOC tiltrotor variant of V-22) PE — closest J-Book match

claims.claim_text: Guided tactical weapons (JDAM, SDB, AIM-9X) are softening: Woodward expects 'overall demand to flatten' with production of some programs decreasing — a self-disclosed weak spot already pressuring FY2024 defense growth.
claims.subject: Woodward
claims.object_value: JDAM + Small Diameter Bomb + AIM-9X (guided tactical weapons)
claims.source_quote: we believe budget increases in recent years will support growth in fiscal year 2024, with the exception of our guided tactical weapons programs. ... Guided tactical weapons programs for which we have sales include the Joint Direct Attack Munition (JDAM), Small Diameter Bomb (SDB), and AIM-9X guided tactical weapon systems. Following multiple years of decline from very strong demand levels, we expect overall demand to flatten for these weapons programs, with production of some programs decreasing and other programs increasing.

queries.rationale: Small Diameter Bomb PE (R-2 line in Air Force J-Book)
